query: For my 43-year-old female, among women 38–48 with heart failure, what's the average 30‑day readmission rate after first HF admission?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, a.dischtime)) <= 30 THEN a.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS readmission_rate FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, a.dischtime)) BETWEEN 38 AND 48 AND a.admission_type = 'HF' AND a.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 43);
